facts.c: Because of the high number of false and counterfeit documents, Italy suspended the validity of all work nulla osta issued to citizens of some countries, including Bangladesh, until verified (Embassy communique, 16 October 2024)
facts.q: Due to the high number of false and counterfeit documents, the Italian Government has suspended the validity of all "Nulla Osta" (work authorizations) released in favour of citizens of some countries, including Bangladesh, until due verification is completed.

facts.c: Under Law Decree 145/2024 the Embassy issues the work visa only after the SUI in Italy confirms the suspended nulla osta has been verified
facts.q: the Embassy will issue the work visa only after receiving confirmation from the provincial immigration office in Italy

facts.c: Suspended work nulla osta do not expire while awaiting confirmation; other visa types (family, study, business, tourism) were not affected
facts.q: The processing of other types of visas (such as family, study, business and tourism) remains unchanged.

facts.c: By 27 May 2025 over 7,000 suspended work visa cases had been issued or rejected after nulla osta re-examination
facts.q: over 7000 work visas have already been either issued or rejected

facts.c: Over 70% of entries on the Embassy's 2025 work-visa webform contained fake or invalid nulla osta
facts.q: over 70% of the entries contain fake or invalid "Nulla Osta" documents

facts.c: VFS Global handles only the logistics of visa applications and has no say in decisions or document checks
facts.q: VFS Global is tasked only with the logistical process of visa applications, and holds no authority over the decision-making

facts.c: Neither the Embassy nor VFS asks for money beyond the published fees or holds a passport against the applicant's will; such cases should be reported to the authorities
facts.q: Neither the Embassy, nor VFS will ever ask applicants for money except for publicly listed fees, or hold an applicant's passport against their will.

facts.c: The Embassy tells applicants who use an agency to check its reputation, take a receipt for every payment and know every document presented in their name
facts.q: ask for a receipt for every sum they pay, and be aware of each and every document that is being presented in their name

facts.c: Applicants must give contact details so VFS can reach them directly, not through an intermediary
facts.q: make sure that VFS is always able to contact them directly and not through an intermediary

facts.c: In September 2025, 944 confirmed nulla osta for Bangladeshis whose holders had not applied for a visa were listed on the VFS website, with walk-in days at the VFS centres in Dhaka, Chattogram and Sylhet
facts.q: Holders of such Nulla Osta are invited to present themselves on Tuesday, 16th September at one of the VFS Visa Application Centres in Dhaka, Chattogram and Sylhet

facts.c: 944 nulla osta had been confirmed by the SUIs for Bangladeshis who had not yet applied for the visa
facts.q: A total of 944 Nulla Osta have been confirmed by the competent Provincial Immigration Offices in Italy

facts.c: Holders of a confirmed nulla osta register on the VFS work-visa portal vfseu.mioot.com/forms/ITABDE/ to get an appointment
facts.q: register in the dedicated work visa portal at https://vfseu.mioot.com/forms/ITABDE/

facts.c: Nulla osta code L/N (Article 27, the 'carta blu' for highly qualified workers) is outside the quota and reserved for highly qualified jobs; holding one does not guarantee a visa
facts.q: Holding a valid Nulla Osta code L/N does not guarantee the issuance of this type of visa

facts.c: Very few Bangladeshi applicants for L/N visas have succeeded; most were not highly qualified
facts.q: Very few applicants of this type of visa in Bangladesh have so far been successful.

facts.c: The Embassy warns against brokers who promise a 'Nulla Osta L/N code - carta blu'
facts.q: We advise the public not to become prey of agents and illegal brokers who promise a "Nulla Osta L/N code - carta blu"

facts.c: TUIR art. 12 (tax deductions for family dependants) is repealed by Legislative Decree 117 of 19 June 2026, in the text in force from 1 January 2027
facts.q: Testo in vigore dal: 1-1-2027 aggiornamenti all'articolo Art. 12 ((PROVVEDIMENTO ABROGATO DAL D.LGS. 19 GIUGNO 2026, N. 117))
